review_text: Bought Cho Wich ( chocolate filled) and Strawberry filled donuts here and when i began eating the Choco wich I noticed that the donuts were cut into halves to put in the chocolate filling, the Strawberry filled were not, and I have never had this done at any of the other Dunking Donuts that I bought Choco wich at before..WHY WERE THEY CUT IN HALF TO PUT IN THE FILLING, WHO DECIDED TO DO THIS ???? NEVER BUY AT DUNKIN' DONUTS IN ABREEZA AGAIN

Had a great experience at Dunkin' in Abreeza Ayala Mall, Davao! The food and coffee were exactly what you'd expect classic, comforting, and affordable. Their service was excellent too, very friendly and efficient, which made the visit even better. The only thing I wish is for them to have a physical store inside the mall instead of just a pop-up. It would be nice to have a cozy space to sit down, relax, and enjoy your donut and coffee in a proper café setup with a good ambiance. Still, highly recommended for a quick snack or caffeine fix when you're at Abreeza! 🍩☕️
